paper_title: Constraints on the Coupling between Axionlike Dark Matter and Photons Using an Antiproton Superconducting Tuned Detection Circuit in a Cryogenic Penning Trap
notes: Limit constrains ALP-to-photon coupling over narrow mass range 2.7906–2.7914 neV/c² around 2.791 neV. Derived from statistical analysis of detector noise spectrum (no ALP signal detected; limit set by noise floor). Fixed-frequency (674.9 kHz) LC resonant detection circuit limits mass range probed. Assumed local dark matter density ρa = 0.4 GeV/cm³. Power-constrained 95% confidence limit from Eq. 12-13. Single-band measurement from antiproton trap analysis trap at BASE, CERN.
